name: Reigning Champ
founders: Craig Atkinson (named as founder by golf.com and the Miura Golf press release)
why_quiet: Monochrome, tonal palette (navy, carbon, heather grey, dust) with at most a mini monogram; the brand's own ethos is 'Respect the Details. Master Simplicity.' Pieces are defined by fabric and construction — Japanese Solotex mesh, Japanese nylon ripstop with PrimaLoft, stretch warp-knit, signature flatlock seams — rather than logos. Note: it is technical/athletic quiet luxury (performance knits, nylon), not merino/cashmere tailoring.

quote.text: our focus has always revolved around an obsession with quality, respect for craft and an unwavering resolve to master simplicity

facts.fact: Founded in Canada in 2007; guiding philosophy 'Respect the Details. Master Simplicity.'
Before launching Reigning Champ in 2007 the company was a private-label manufacturer; fabrics developed with partner mills or sourced from specialist manufacturers.
Signature flatlock seam; a garment may pass through up to a hundred skilled hands.
Vancouver-based; Craig Atkinson named founder (also founded wings+horns; CEO of CYC Design Corporation).
First golf collaboration: Miura Golf x Reigning Champ, May 2024 — MB-101 irons ($2,800) plus an 8-piece all-black apparel capsule with tonal logos.
PUMA Golf x Reigning Champ collection released 2025 (date per press: July 2025 — UNVERIFIED on official site).
Dedicated Men's Golf collection on the US store (67 products at time of check, 2026-10-28), prices in USD, free US shipping over $50.
'Made in Canada' for the golf pieces: UNVERIFIED (not stated on the pages checked).

picks.desc: A moisture-wicking mesh polo designed to keep you cool in all conditions. Solotex® Mesh is a breathable performance fabric with dynamic stretch, high rebound, and a smooth knit reverse. Designed with a self-fabric collar, metal snaps, semi-raglan sleeves, and side panel construction for unrestricted movement.

Our premium cotton pique polo is soft, breathable, and designed for warm‑weather wear. Finished with mini monogram embroidery at the chest, it features a flat knit collar and cuffs, a two‑button placket, and set‑in sleeves for a clean, polished fit.

picks.t: Stretch Warp Knit Coach's Slim Pant
picks.desc: This versatile pant bridges the gap between athletic wear and lifestyle attire, allowing for seamless transition between the office, sideline, and back nine. The Coach’s series is made from a sophisticated stretch knit fabric to ensure effortless comfort on the move. Designed with an elastic belt loop waistband, reverse coil zip pockets and front fly, rear welt pockets, and a diamond crotch gusset

This insulated zip vest is crafted with a durable and water-repellent nylon ripstop sourced from Japan. Featuring a standard fit with full-cut torso and sleeves, and PrimaLoft® insulation for lightweight warmth. Designed with a mock neck collar, YKK Vislon two-way zip closure, inseam zip pockets, an interior chest pocket, and an adjustable shock cord hem.

This two-way stretch nylon jacket is designed for movement on and off-field. Featuring an oxford weave reverse, it's abrasion-resistant and treated with a durable water-repellent finish. Designed with a mock neck collar, YKK Vislon two-way zipper, front zip welt pockets, half-elasticated cuffs, and an adjustable hem with shock cord.
